## Summary

(*Describe the problem, request, or open question and why it matters. Separate evidence from hypotheses.*)

(*Optional: add only relevant H2 sections without repeating Summary. Examples:*)

- (*Desired Outcome — observable result or decision sought*)

- (*Verification Plan — experiment and stop condition for open questions*)
- (*Scope & Risks — boundaries, exclusions, dependencies, or unresolved risks*)
- (*References — related Issues, canonical documents, or links*)
